data_fields.name: falloff_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: gain = base x (1 - d/(range+1)), 0 beyond range; d = max(|dx|,|dy|)

best_idea: Attenuate a cue by Chebyshev tile distance, fading to silence at the view range plus one, and refuse to restart a clip until its own length has passed.
decision_why: Take the falloff and per-clip lockout as a client cue layer with view range as zone data, but recompute gain each frame and key the lockout per attacker so three hits at once are not dropped; the donor's trigger-time gain and drop-on-retrigger would hide many-on-one hits.
acceptance: With three attackers hitting the player, three distinct hit clips start; a clip 6 tiles away is quieter than one at 1 tile and silent beyond the zone view range (client test asserts gain order and three keyed hits start).
